claims.head: Shots should fly both ways
claims.call: The game runs at more than the two teams’ usual 86.8 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5.
claims.body: Pittsburgh’s games average 84.5 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined (5th of 32 for pace); Colorado’s average 89.0 (1st).

check.measure: unblocked shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined, adjusted for score and venue
check.rule: held if tonight's pace is above the two teams' average; partly if above the league average; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Colorado shoots from the point; Pittsburgh works down low
claims.body: Colorado ranks 1st of 32 for point-shot reliance, toward the point-heavy end; Pittsburgh ranks 25th, toward the down low end.
claims.call: Colorado takes a bigger share of its shots from the point than Pittsburgh.

COL.head: Colorado should have the upper hand
COL.body: Colorado has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Pittsburgh’s way back in is a penalty kill that holds up.

PIT.head: Pittsburgh faces a real test
PIT.body: Colorado has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Pittsburgh can pull it off if its penalty kill holds up.
